name: Lawrence
source:
Despite belonging to one of the physically strongest races, werewolf Lawrence gets often mistaken for a cat.

Deadpan as he may look, Lawrence is surprisingly silly and lazily efficient.

[From [url=https://nifty-visuals.itch.io/witches-x-warlocks]itch.io[/url]]
